Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for taking this on. We're kicking off the vendor security intake for Redwood as part of our procurement cycle. To keep things tight on our side, could you please: 

- Upload the latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) and point us to the portal profile where we can download artifacts.
- Share a populated SIG control matrix or CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet) that aligns Redwood controls to our vendor questions.
- Provide an evidence manifest listing S3 locations (or links) where PDFs and logs live, plus the contact who can perform a short evidence walkthrough next week.

If you can get the items up by Monday EOD our security team will do a quick pass and book a follow-up 30-min call.

Required fields for our intake system: vendor portal URL, primary security contact, attestation dates, and links to the file artifacts.

Thanks —
